faq.label: Questions
faq.title: Everything you need to know before you enter.

items.q: Who is Atlantix Lab built for?
items.a: One operator with conviction — a discretionary trader, family office PM or prop-desk lead who wants an agentic committee on the record instead of a black-box autotrader.
No. Nothing executes until the owner approves. The terminal proposes — the operator commits. Every order is logged with the originating debate and risk verdict.

items.q: What data sources are connected live?
items.a: Alpaca for execution and portfolio state, Yahoo Finance for prices and history, FRED for macro series, an aggregated news API, and CCXT for crypto. System Health surfaces every API status in real time.

items.q: How does the RAG memory work?
items.a: Trade memos, journals and ingested news are embedded into a Supabase vector store. Every assistant answer cites the underlying memo or trade by ID — clickable, auditable, never hallucinated.

items.q: What happens if the risk engine vetoes a trade?
items.a: It blocks. Edge score never overrides risk. The veto reason is logged, the debate stays in the journal, and the operator sees both the agent consensus and the risk decision side by side.

scenarios.label: See it in action
scenarios.subtitle: Here is exactly what happens from the moment you spot an idea to the moment you place the order.

items.title: You spot AKBNK breaking out
items.body: Add it to Watchlist with a trigger note: 'Breakout above 52W high on volume.' The system tracks it alongside your other candidates.

items.title: Promote to Debate Room
items.body: One click sends the idea to the committee. 13 agents receive the thesis and begin arguing — Macro checks the regime, Fundamental checks the valuation, Bear looks for the hole.

items.title: Committee delivers a verdict
items.body: 7 agents FOR, 3 CAUTION, 2 AGAINST, 1 RISK VETO. The Risk Officer caps position at 6% NAV and sets a mandatory stop at -1.5R. The debate is on the record.

items.title: You review and approve
items.body: You read the full transcript, check the Investment Memo, and click Approve. The order moves to Execution Console — nothing executes without your signature.

items.title: Trade closes. Post-mortem runs.
items.body: When you close the position, the system scores every agent's stance against the realized P&L. The Memory agent stores the lesson. Next time AKBNK comes up, the committee already knows.

nextSteps.label: What to do next
nextSteps.subtitle: Here is the exact path from first login to your first committee-approved trade.

steps.title: Create your operator account
steps.body: Sign up and access the Command Center. Your portfolio, watchlist and agent memory are private to your account.

steps.title: Add your first idea to Watchlist
steps.body: Pick a ticker you already have a view on. Add a trigger note. This is your starting point — not a blank screen.

steps.title: Run the committee
steps.body: Promote the idea to the Debate Room and click Run Committee. Watch 13 agents argue your thesis in real time.

steps.title: Read the verdict. Approve or reject.
steps.body: The Risk Officer will give you a position cap and a stop-loss. If you agree — approve. If not — reject and log the reason.

steps.title: Close the trade. Run the post-mortem.
steps.body: After the trade closes, run the post-mortem in Journal. The system scores the agents and stores the lesson in memory.

dataSource.label: Data source
dataSource.portfolio: Positions and P&L are synced from your Alpaca broker via the broker-sync-portfolio cron job.
dataSource.macro: Macro series come from the FRED API (rates, CPI, DXY, unemployment); refreshed daily by macro-snapshot.
dataSource.journal: Trade journal is built automatically from closed positions; post-mortems are written by generate-postmortem.
dataSource.news: News is fetched through NewsAPI + KAP integrations by the ingest-news job.
dataSource.ideas: Ideas are added by the operator or surfaced by the score-idea / fundamental-snapshot scanners.
dataSource.debate: Debates are produced by real Gemini agents through the run-committee function; every message is persisted to agent_debates.
